_note: World-map sea creatures (docs/09, docs/28): attackable monsters, event bosses and cosmetic schools. Same TRELLIS path as assets.json (ROSTER=creatures.json art/gpu/batch_3d.sh creatures), then art/blender/props.py --roster art/gpu/creatures.json --out-dir Assets/_Hadal/Art/Creatures. Designs are our own text prompts; the sample models in the user's Downloads folder were only looked at for silhouettes and none of their meshes or textures are used. "yaw" turns the mesh in Blender so its head points +Z in Unity; "budget" is the triangle cap and "texture" the albedo size.
